description: A comprehensive academic and career hub for university students. Pengu simplifies student life with expert assignment help, ATS-optimized resume building, and automated syllabus tracking.
description_bn: বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ের শিক্ষার্থীদের জন্য একটি বিস্তৃত একাডেমিক এবং ক্যারিয়ার হাব। পেঙ্গু বিশেষজ্ঞ অ্যাসাইনমেন্ট সহায়তা, ATS-অপ্টিমাইজ করা জীবনবৃত্তান্ত বিল্ডিং এবং স্বয়ংক্রিয় সিলেবাস ট্র্যাকিংয়ের মাধ্যমে ছাত্রজীবনকে সহজ করে তোলে।
impact:
By unifying academic and career services into one seamless platform, Pengu drastically improved the student experience:

Increased Academic Success: Students reported significantly higher grades and better understanding of complex topics thanks to the step-by-step expert guidance and plagiarism-free support.

Higher Career Placement: The Career Vault and expert CV building tools directly resulted in a higher percentage of users landing internships and post-graduation jobs.

Massive Time Saved: The Syllabus Sync and centralized resource curation saved users countless hours of administrative tracking, resulting in a highly engaged, loyal user base with exceptional retention rates.
problem: University students are overwhelmed by the sheer volume of their responsibilities. Juggling complex assignments, technical coding projects, lengthy research papers, and the looming pressure of the job market leads to massive burnout. Previously, students had to jump between a dozen fragmented, poorly designed tools to get tutoring, format citations, track their syllabus, and build their resumes. This disorganized workflow was costing them time, grades, and future career opportunities.
solution: I designed and developed Pengu to be a centralized, stress-free ecosystem that handles everything a student needs from freshman year to their first job. The strategy focused on reducing cognitive overload through a clean, intuitive UI/UX design, making it incredibly easy to navigate between diverse services. On the development side, I built a robust, scalable full-stack architecture capable of managing expert team matching, secure document uploads for editing, and complex data tracking for the syllabus and career features.
title: Project Pengu: The Ultimate Academic & Career Success Hub for University Students

problem:
The pizza delivery market is saturated, yet most apps suffer from three specific "UX friction" points:

Re-order Fatigue: Users often order the same thing, but have to navigate the entire menu every time.

The "Guilt" Barrier: Pizza is often viewed as "unhealthy" because standard apps hide nutritional data, leading to cart abandonment by health-conscious users.

solution:
Gemini said
This project, which we can call "SlicePoint," represents a specialized niche in the food-tech world: The High-Speed Pizza Customizer. Unlike the general healthy-eating vibe of GoFresh, this app is built for speed, macro-tracking, and deep customization.

Here is the Case Study breakdown for SlicePoint:

🍕 Case Study: SlicePoint – The Future of Fast-Casual Pizza
Case Study Title: SlicePoint: Streamlining the Art of the Pizza Order via Data-Driven UX

Category: Product Design & Mobile App Development

Short Summary: SlicePoint is a high-end pizza delivery application that bridges the gap between indulgent "cheat meals" and fitness tracking. By integrating a clean, "Soft-UI" aesthetic with real-time nutritional macro-data and a friction-free re-ordering engine, the app ensures that users can customize, track, and order their perfect pizza in under 60 seconds.

🚩 The Problem
The pizza delivery market is saturated, yet most apps suffer from three specific "UX friction" points:

Re-order Fatigue: Users often order the same thing, but have to navigate the entire menu every time.

The "Guilt" Barrier: Pizza is often viewed as "unhealthy" because standard apps hide nutritional data, leading to cart abandonment by health-conscious users.

Clunky Customization: Adding or removing toppings (e.g., +$1.00 for mushrooms) is often buried in sub-menus, making the final price a surprise at checkout.

💡 The Solution & Strategy
The strategy for SlicePoint was to create a "Macro-Transparent" ordering flow:

The "Order Again" Fast-Lane: Placed a high-visibility horizontal scroll of previous orders at the top of the home screen, reducing the journey from "App Open" to "Checkout" to just three taps.

Nutritional Logic: Every pizza detail page features a "Macro-Bar" (Calories, Protein, Fats, Carbs). As users add toppings like Pepperoni or Mushrooms, these numbers update dynamically, providing a sense of control and transparency.

Visual Modifiers: Instead of list-based checkboxes, toppings are presented as large, tappable cards with clear price markers, making the customization process feel like a premium "build-your-own" experience.

Design System: Utilized the Gilroy typeface and a specific high-contrast palette (#eb3254 Red & #2b2626 Charcoal) to create a modern, energetic brand identity that stands out from legacy competitors.
title: SlicePoint: Streamlining the Art of the Pizza Order via Data-Driven UX

description: GoFresh is a premium mobile solution designed to eliminate the friction between health-conscious consumers and high-quality nutrition. By combining a "Visual-First" interface with real-time logistics tracking and granular ingredient transparency, the app transforms food delivery from a utility into a lifestyle habit.
description_bn: GoFresh হল একটি প্রিমিয়াম মোবাইল সলিউশন যা স্বাস্থ্য-সচেতন ভোক্তা এবং উচ্চ-মানের পুষ্টির মধ্যে ঘর্ষণ দূর করার জন্য ডিজাইন করা হয়েছে। রিয়েল-টাইম লজিস্টিক ট্র্যাকিং এবং দানাদার উপাদানের স্বচ্ছতার সাথে একটি "ভিজ্যুয়াল-ফার্স্ট" ইন্টারফেস একত্রিত করে, অ্যাপটি একটি ইউটিলিটি থেকে খাদ্য সরবরাহকে একটি জীবনযাত্রার অভ্যাসে রূপান্তরিত করে৷
impact:
Increased Conversion: The 3-step "Add to Cart" flow and social login integration reduce checkout time by an estimated 40%.

Higher Retention: Features like "Favorite Dishes" and "Quick Reorder" encourage habit-forming behavior, increasing Customer Lifetime Value (CLV).

Brand Authority: Detailed ingredient lists and calorie counters position the brand as a premium health partner, allowing for higher average order values compared to standard fast-food apps.
problem:
Traditional food delivery platforms often overwhelm users with "decision fatigue" and lack transparency regarding nutritional value. Health-conscious users face three primary pain points:

Hidden Ingredients: Difficulty finding exact caloric or allergen information before ordering.

Tracking Anxiety: Uncertain delivery windows leading to a poor user experience.

High Friction: Clunky onboarding and checkout flows that lead to abandoned carts in the middle of the "hunger window."
solution:
The strategy for GoFresh was to build a "Transparent Ecosystem" through three core pillars:

Nutritional Clarity: Every dish detail page was engineered to highlight Calories, Ingredients, and "Special for You" tags (e.g., Vegan, Seafood) to empower informed choices.

Hyper-Visual UX: Using floating 3D-style food assets and a clean green-accented palette to trigger "Visual Hunger" while maintaining a sense of health and cleanliness.

Real-Time Feedback Loops: Implementing a live GPS tracking system and step-by-step status updates (Kitchen -> Prepared -> Arrived) to eliminate user anxiety and build brand trust.
title: GoFresh: Engineering a Frictionless "Farm-to-Phone" Nutritional Experience
